description:
Intent i011 (loop-parser-stale-state, snapshot s03) complete. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i011.json with 2 findings, 4 candidates, 4 limitations.

FINDING 1 (medium, new variant): s03:net/mpls/af_mpls.c:199-235, mpls_multipath_hash(). UNTRUSTED SOURCE: forwarded MPLS packets whose label stack length, BOS flag, and following IPv4/IPv6 payload are sender-controlled; called from mpls_select_multipath() (line 275) when a route has multiple nexthops. CAPTURED STATE: hdr = mpls_hdr(skb) + label_index at line 194 inside the MAX_MP_SELECT_LABELS for-loop — raw pointer into skb->head. INTERIOR PULL: pskb_may_pull(skb, mpls_hdr_len) at line 192, pskb_may_pull(skb, mpls_hdr_len + sizeof(struct iphdr)) at line 222, and the ipv6 variant at 227-228, any of which can run __pskb_pull_tail()/pskb_expand_head() and free skb->head (documented in net/core/skbuff.c: all header pointers must be reloaded); hdr is never refetched. STALE USE: v4hdr = (const struct iphdr *)(hdr + 1) at line 224 (quote verified literal), dereferenced for version/saddr/daddr/protocol at 225-230, and v6hdr = (const struct ipv6hdr *)(hdr + 1) at 232 with saddr/daddr/nexthdr reads at 233-235 — jhash inputs that select the forwarding nexthop, i.e. a kernel state transition computed from possibly freed slab memory, the loop-parser analogue of pep_get_sb(). Counterevidence expressed as limitations: read-only, requires a cloned/non-linear skb at that offset plus MPLS multipath config; no KASAN reproducer run.

FINDING 2 (high, baseline): the seed mechanism itself is still present unpatched in s03 at net/phonet/pep.c:55-61 (quote verified: 'if (ph == NULL || ph->sb_len < 2 || !pskb_may_pull(skb, ph->sb_len))'), with ph->sb_len -= 2 WRITE at 59 and ph->sb_type read at 60, driven from the record loops at 312/497/824.

SAFE: net/802/garp.c garp_pdu_parse_attr (line 447-486) is the FIXED shape in s03 — it refetches ga = (struct garp_attr_hdr *)skb->data at line 455 after the variable-length pull at 453, unlike s04 where the same function was reported by i014. net/phonet/pep.c:258 pull-before-capture sites are safe.

LIMITATIONS: full-tree automated loop scan was terminated by harness timeout; evidence is from targeted grep/reads of the highest-signal loop-parser files plus shared knowledge from sibling s03 audits; other TLV/option loops (x25, ipv6 exthdrs, ipvs, l2tp, batman-adv, nfc, act_csum, xfrm) were screened but not all line-verified in s03; drivers/, arch/, fs/ parse loops not audited.
